hypotheses.title: Operating Cashflow Yield & Volume Accumulation Synergy (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share measures pure realized cash conversion free of accounting accrual manipulation. Securities with expanding 180-day cash flow yields that are simultaneously experiencing relative volume accumulation (volume / adv20) reflect institutional smart-money accumulation ahead of earnings announcements. Decay 5 and Subindustry neutralization compress turnover into the 11-12% optimal frontier, driving Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Sudden non-recurring asset sales inflating trailing cash flow figures
High volume caused by institutional forced liquidation rather than accumulation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad speculative junk-rally regimes where low-cash speculative stocks lead the market.

candidates.expression: 0.70 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(actual_cashflow_per_share_value_quarterly, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.20 * group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Balance Sheet Deleveraging & Volatility Contraction Anomaly (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms aggressively reducing liabilities relative to assets over trailing 60 days (-ts_delta(liabilities / assets, 60)) experience structural credit risk contraction. Conditioning deleveraging momentum with negative historical realized volatility isolates calm, solvent compounders undergoing balance sheet de-risking and equity multiple expansion. Zero overlap with call implied volatility guarantees complete portfolio decorrelation (Self-corr <= 0.35).
confounders: Distressed fire-sales of productive assets used to service immediate debt maturities
Subdued volatility reflecting illiquid trading rather than operational stability
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during rapid credit expansion cycles where highly leveraged distressed equities drastically outperform.

hypotheses.title: Consensus EPS Revision Acceleration & Value Convexity (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Sell-side analysts adjust earnings estimates gradually due to anchoring bias, producing post-earnings announcement drift. Evaluating the 180-day historical time-series rank of consensus median EPS (anl4_afv4_median_eps / close) combined with 60-day forecast revision delta isolates equities undergoing accelerating institutional consensus upgrades. Convex signed_power decile weighting concentrates capital into top conviction consensus upgrades.
confounders: Sell-side herd mentality where consensus estimates lag turning points at market tops
One-off accounting write-downs distorting consensus comparison baselines
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during macro shocks where headline earnings guidance is rendered obsolete across entire sectors.

candidates.expression: 0.70 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_median_eps, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_median_eps, 60), 60) / close, subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
